project.title: Tatabq
project.shortDesc: The Trusted Platform for Balance Matching Between Companies Electronically.

overview.about: Tatabq is the trusted platform for electronic balance matching between companies. It provides a documented and secure way to verify balances, integrated with Nafath for secure establishment login. Companies can easily choose their establishment and start the matching process from anywhere.
overview.goal: To streamline and document the balance matching process, ensuring transparency and legal compliance between corporate entities.
overview.audience: Accounting departments, CFOs, auditors, and business owners.

challenge.description: Ensuring the legal validity of electronic matching and integrating with national identity systems (Nafath) while maintaining a seamless user experience for corporate users.

solution.description: We developed a robust FinTech ecosystem that handles complex matching workflows. The system generates legally binding documentation and provides real-time status tracking for all matching requests.
solution.approach: Building a secure-by-design platform focused on legal documentation and ease of access.

features.desc: Secure establishment login and identity verification via the national access portal.

design.philosophy: Trusted and Professional. Using a clean, corporate aesthetic that emphasizes security and reliability.

results.impact: Facilitated over 5,000 documented matching requests in the first month and reduced manual documentation time by 80%.
